headlines.title: Netanyahu joins Trump for high-stakes meeting at the White House
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to meet with President Donald Trump and attend the late Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral.

headlines.title: A major earthquake strikes southern Japan
headlines.description: The Japan Meteorological Agency said the earthquake, with a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 and a depth of just over 6 miles, was at the highest end of the seismic intensity scale. NBC News' Raf Sanchez reports on the initial damage caused by the earthquake.

headlines.title: Kentucky governor tells Mitch McConnell to prove he can serve or ‘resign’ from Senate
headlines.description: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear is giving Sen. Mitch McConnell, R-Ky., an ultimatum, demanding that he prove he’s still capable of serving in the U.S. Senate — or resign.

headlines.title: Tornado Flattens Wisconsin Neighborhoods as Storm Moves East
headlines.description: A destructive tornado tore through Wisconsin on Monday, leaving entire neighborhoods flattened. The twister is part of a powerful severe storm system that slammed multiple states and that is now moving east. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports and Weekend TODAY meteorologist Angie Lassman tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Manhunt for suspect in deadly shootout at Seattle food festival
headlines.description: Police also arrested a 15-year-old who they said was one of the gunmen. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Nasdaq-100 slides into correction as global chip and memory stocks sell off
headlines.description: Chip stocks around the world sold off sharply, the latest chapter in the monthslong jitters surrounding artificial intelligence, memory and chip stocks.

headlines.title: Search for North Carolina woman Liz Waddell is still a missing person case, Grenada police say
headlines.description: Grenadian police said Tuesday that their nearly week-old search for a missing North Carolina woman is still active, with hopes of finding the swimmer alive.

headlines.title: Washington says goodbye to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: A special ceremony at the Capitol and a funeral service at the National Cathedral on Tuesday will be private, but both events will be livestreamed for the public.

headlines.title: Major earthquake rocks southern Japan, injuring dozens
headlines.description: A 6.8-magnitude earthquake rocked southern Japan on Tuesday, forcing hundreds of thousands of people to evacuate and prompting the collapse of several buildings, including a shopping mall.

headlines.title: How to prevent boob sweat, according to experts
headlines.description: Beyond making you uncomfortable, boob sweat can cause painful sweat rashes under the breasts. Experts share the best boob sweat solutions and how to treat intertrigo.
